title: The unit-test check runs the project suite as a gate and fails non-zero on any failing test
asA: operator whose project has a unit-test suite
iWant: a unit-test gate whose exit-code and report shape are the same as every other elicited check
soThat: the aggregate report treats unit tests as one gate among many with the same downstream contract

acceptanceCriteria.description: When `checkSet.unitTest` is true, the gate-runner runs the project-realised unit-test runner. A non-zero exit code flips the gate outcome to `failed`. The per-gate report at `.rcf/reports/ci/test.json` carries `checkKind: "unitTest"`. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with `checkSet.unitTest: true` and a realised unit-test runner
acceptanceCriteria.when: a CI workflow invokes the gate-runner
acceptanceCriteria.then: a report file at `.rcf/reports/ci/test.json` is written with `checkKind: "unitTest"`, and the gate outcome tracks the runner exit code

acceptanceCriteria.description: The unit-test gate refuses to declare a pass when the underlying test runner exits 0 but the tap/junit-shaped output reports at least one `fail` line; the gate parses the runner's test-report artefact and takes the stricter of exit code and parsed status.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a unit-test runner that exits 0 but emits a tap output with `not ok` on one test
acceptanceCriteria.then: the per-gate report writes verdict=failed naming the failing test id and pointing at the tap artefact

description: Section 7a floor: two ACs. Guide and TAC-701 name no unit-test-specific failure paths beyond runner-missing (AC-6102-3), gate-aggregation gaps (AC-6108-1), and the exit-zero-but-parsed-failures path bound by AC-6119-2; this story owns the unit-test-specific gate mechanics (per-gate report at .rcf/reports/ci/test.json with checkKind=unitTest, tap-parsed strict verdict).
